name: Demo G: Add Move Delete and Link Model Primitives
description: Create a benchmark family instance, move it with dry-run and apply evidence, delete it with dry-run and apply evidence, link an RVT model with dry-run and apply evidence, capture post-change visual proof, then clean up the linked instance and link type for repeat-safe live runs.
setup_instructions: Use a disposable benchmark symbol that can be safely placed in the active model.
Prefer a generic annotation, detail item, or other low-risk non-hosted/level-hosted family symbol.
Provide a disposable RVT link source under the workspace or OPERATOR_ALLOWED_EXTERNAL_ROOTS.
The workflow deletes the created benchmark element, linked RVT instance, and RVT link type so repeated runs do not accumulate test elements or loaded links.
success_criteria: /revit/create-family-instance returns family/type/name evidence matching the requested disposable symbol.
/revit/move-elements dry-run returns the requested benchmark id and rolls back.
/revit/move-elements apply returns the requested benchmark id.
/revit/delete dry-run returns the requested benchmark id as deletable.
/revit/delete apply returns the requested benchmark id as deleted.
/revit/link-revit apply returns a link type id and link instance id.
/revit/link-revit apply proves the linked source path matches the requested source.
/revit/link-revit apply proves the pinned state matches the requested pin value.
A post-change capture is produced while the linked RVT instance is still present.
/revit/delete dry-run and apply remove the linked RVT instance after link evidence is captured.
/revit/delete dry-run and apply remove the linked RVT type after the instance is removed.
A model edit primitives summary artifact is written.
The summary records the linked RVT instance/type ids and cleanup ids.
failure_criteria: Family instance creation returns no id.
Family instance creation returns an id for a different family/type/symbol than requested.
Move dry-run or apply does not report the benchmark id.
Delete dry-run or apply does not report the benchmark id.
The RVT link request is missing or link apply returns no instance id.
The RVT link apply evidence omits or mismatches the requested source path.
The RVT link apply evidence omits or mismatches the requested pin value.
The post-change visual capture is missing before linked-model cleanup.
The linked RVT instance cleanup does not report the linked instance id.
The linked RVT type cleanup does not report the linked type id.
grader_notes: This benchmark covers add/move/delete and RVT linking primitives. Live runs must use a disposable RVT link source and visually verify the linked model instance is present.
